copy.headline: Fort Worth restaurant will reopen nearly three years after hotel explosion
copy.caption: At Musume, fresh fish is flown in daily from Japan, showcasing sushi and sashimi along with Fort Worth’s largest sake collection. Over 80% of its staff return.
